entities.summary: Religious law includes ethical and moral codes taught by religious traditions. Examples of religiously derived legal codes include Christian canon law, Jewish halakha, Islamic sharia, and Hindu law. In some jurisdictions, religious law may apply only to that religion's adherents; in others, it may be enforced by civil authorities for all residents.
